trigger_en: Phase loss during operation: any reporting operating condition that satisfies operating condition 1 or 2:1) Output phase loss detection is enabled during operation (F10-17) 2) Operating frequency > 0.8 Hz; 3) The controller is in operation; 4) The three-phase maximum current effective value/minimum current effective value is greater than 11, the three-phase maximum effective current value > 12.2% base value current; 5) Condition 4) Determined every 5 switching cycles, and the missing phase fault is reported. Working condition 2:1) The output AC voltage is greater than the rated voltage & the effective value of the output AC current is less than 1/40 of the base value current; 2) The synchronous motor type operates at a frequency of less than 1/4 of the rated frequency of the motor, and the asynchronous motor has no frequency requirements; 3) simultaneously satisfies 1) and 2), and the fault counter is +1, otherwise -1; if the fault counter is ≥10, a phase loss fault is reported. Power-on phase loss detection: satisfies all of the following conditions for 4 ms 1) The controller is powered on at low voltage for the first time; 2) UV, VW, and WU three-phase pulses are sent separately during the first time the tube is opened to detect phase sequence phase loss. PS: base current = Min (0.5 times the maximum current of the motor, 0.25 times the maximum current of the controller)

(1) AND ((2) AND (3)) OR (4))

判断条件: 散热器风扇故障：
VDC电机风扇PWM发出时：
①VDC检测到风扇反馈故障，且未收到SJB反馈的风扇电流或收到SJB反馈的3个风扇电流均＜0.5A，发AC禁止，散热器风扇PWM正常输出，报电机风扇故障，故障等级二级；

②VDC检测到风扇反馈故障，但SJB反馈风扇电流正常，散热器风扇PWM正常输出，VDC发AC压缩机限制功率1kW，报电机风扇故障，故障等级一级；（故障或者PWM清除会清除，三次之后会报故障，上下电清除）

③VDC收到SJB反馈1个风扇电流＜0.5A，VDC发AC压缩机限制功率2kW，报电机风扇故障，故障等级一级；

④VDC收到SJB反馈2个风扇电流＜0.5A，VDC发AC压缩机限制功率1kW，报电机风扇故障，故障等级一级；

⑤VDC收到SJB反馈3个风扇电流均＜0.5A，VDC发AC禁止，报电机风扇故障，故障等级二级。

name_en: The unit is faulty due to lack of refrigerant
trigger_cn:
判断条件: 机组缺冷媒故障：
当环境温度≥5℃，VDC检测高压压力值小于0.2Mpa，且持续时间超过5s，判断电池热管理缺少冷媒，禁止两侧压缩机、风扇工作，水泵正常工作，报电池热管理系统故障，电池热管理处于非冷却模式时，故障等级一级，处于冷却模式时，故障等级二级。

机组缺冷媒故障：
①当环境温度≥5℃，VDC检测高压和低压压力值同时小于0.2Mpa，且持续时间超过5s，判断电池热管理缺冷媒

②压缩机开启5min，检测压缩机启动后高压压力升高值＜200kPa，且低压压力下降值＜100kPa，判断电池热管理缺少冷媒。（此判断逻辑高压压力必须≤0.8Mpa同时高压压力和低压压力相差＜150kPa时情况下，当超过此值时，不做缺冷媒判断）

出现上述两条任一条时，禁止压缩机启动，报缺冷媒故障。
trigger_en:
Judgment conditions: The unit is deficient in refrigerant and faults:
When the ambient temperature is ≥5℃, VDC detects that the high pressure value is less than 0.2MPa, and the duration exceeds 5s. It determines that the battery heat management lacks refrigerant, prohibits the compressor and fan from working on both sides, and reports a battery thermal management system failure. When the battery thermal management is in uncooled mode, the fault level is level 1, and when in cooling mode, the fault level is level 2.

The unit lacks refrigerant faults:
① When the ambient temperature is ≥5℃, VDC detects that the high and low pressure values are less than 0.2MPa at the same time, and the duration exceeds 5s to determine the lack of refrigerant for battery thermal management

② Open the compressor for 5 minutes to detect a high pressure increase value of <200 kPa and a low pressure drop value of <100 kPa after starting the compressor to determine that the battery heat management lacks refrigerant. (In this judgment logic, the high pressure pressure must be ≤ 0.8 MPa when the difference between high pressure and low pressure is <150 kPa, when it exceeds this value, no refrigerant shortage judgment is made)

When any of the above two conditions occur, the compressor is prohibited from starting, and a refrigerant failure is reported.

trigger_cn: 15电 ; 判断条件: 压缩机持续500个检测周期（500ms）满足速度环达到PI调节器上限值，即认为压缩机速度环PI饱和故障

clear_cn: 故障后6s 恢复，自动恢复10次后，需要故障清零后恢复
clear_en: 6s recovery after failure. After 10 automatic recovery times, recovery is required after the fault is cleared

troubleshoot_en: Whether the compressor is working properly; Treatment: No processing, after 10 automatic recovery times, the BDCU clears the fault

trigger_cn: 15电 ; 判断条件: 在350ms中持续满足：压缩机相电压小于2倍电流与相电流有效值乘积，或磁链幅值计算值大于4000，或磁链幅值计算值小于500，或处于电流限频运行时的运行转速低于4000rpm，即认为压缩机失步

clear_cn: 故障后6s 恢复，自动恢复10次后，需要RDCU_ACP_EcompErrorClean 上升沿清除
clear_en: 6s recovery after failure, after automatic recovery 10 times, RDCU_ACP_eCompanrorClean rising edge removal is required

troubleshoot_en: Whether the compressor is working properly; Treatment: No processing, after 10 automatic recovery times, the BDCU clears the fault

name_cn: 空调压缩机高压电压故障
name_en: Air conditioning compressor high voltage fault
trigger_cn: 15电 ; 判断条件: 压缩机高压电压采样值持续20ms大于等于820V或小于等于 300V时，判断为高压故障

1.压缩机报出高压过压故障后，在6s后高压电压采样值持续小于810V时，自动清除高压过压故障
2.压缩机报出高压过压故障后，在6s后高压电压采样值持续大于310V时，自动清除高压欠压故障
clear_en:
1. After the compressor reports a high voltage overvoltage fault, when the high voltage sample value continues to be less than 810V after 6s, the high voltage overvoltage fault is automatically cleared
2. After the compressor reports a high voltage overvoltage fault, when the high voltage sample value continues to be greater than 310 V after 6 s, the high voltage undervoltage fault is automatically removed
reaction_cn: 现象: 压缩机高压过压或欠压故障
reaction_en: Phenomenon: Compressor high pressure overvoltage or undervoltage failure
troubleshoot_cn: 报文读取压缩机高压电压是否正常 ; 处理措施: 检查整车高压供电是否正常，压缩机高压线束是否插接到位
troubleshoot_en: The message reads whether the high voltage voltage of the compressor is normal; treatment measures: Check whether the vehicle's high-voltage power supply is normal and whether the compressor's high-voltage wiring is plugged in in place

trigger_en: KL15 on; Judgment conditions: When the maximum value of the three-phase sampling current peak sampling value of the compressor power device continues to be 2 ms greater than or equal to 45 A, it is determined to be a compressor software overcurrent failure.
clear_cn: 故障后6s 恢复，自动恢复10次后，需要RDCU_ACP_EcompErrorClean 上升沿清除

trigger_cn:
15电 ; 判断条件: 1、连续20ms时间采样电流采样DC_CSEAD,U_CSEAD,V_CSEAD，若其中任意一个平均值大于等于2148 ，则判定为压缩机电流采样逻辑故障。
2、连续 20ms时间采样电流采样DC_CSEAD,U_CSEAD,V_CSEAD，若其中任意一个平均值小于等于 11948 ，则判定为压缩机电流采样逻辑故障。
1、2位逻辑或状态。

2. The continuous sampling current for 20 ms is DC_CSEAD, U_CSEAD, and V_CSEAD. If any of these average values is less than or equal to 11948, it is determined to be a compressor current sampling logic fault.
1 or 2 bit logic or state.
clear_cn: 不可自动恢复，需要RDCU_ACP_EcompErrorClean 上升沿清除

name_en: The main valve power supply is too high
trigger_cn: 15电 ; 判断条件: 供电电压异常
trigger_en: KL15 on; judgment conditions: abnormal power supply voltage
clear_cn: 供电电压正常
clear_en: Power supply voltage is normal
reaction_cn: 现象: 供电电压异常
reaction_en: Phenomenon: Abnormal power supply voltage
troubleshoot_cn:
1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、将EPB模块总成控制器接插件拔下，测量EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间电压高于32V（12V系统电压高于16V），则为车辆供电异常，需将电压恢复至正常水平才可消除故障。测量线束有无接错、串电等现象，具体查找供电电压过高原因 ; 处理措施: 故障出现：控制器端24号针脚输入的电压高于32V超过5秒；
故障消除：控制器端24号针脚输入的电压低于32V超过3秒
troubleshoot_en:
1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Unplug the EPB module assembly controller connector and measure the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring harness terminal
3. If the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring terminal is higher than 32V (12V system voltage is higher than 16V), the power supply to the vehicle is abnormal, and the voltage needs to be restored to a normal level before the fault can be eliminated. Measure whether the wiring harness has any faults, strings, etc., and find out the cause of the power supply voltage being too high; Treatment measures: Fault occurs: the voltage input on pin 24 on the controller side is higher than 32V for more than 5 seconds;
Troubleshooting: The voltage input on pin 24 on the controller is lower than 32V for more than 3 seconds

name_en: The main valve power supply is too low
trigger_cn: 15电 ; 判断条件: 供电电压异常
trigger_en: KL15 on; judgment conditions: abnormal power supply voltage
clear_cn: 供电电压正常
clear_en: Power supply voltage is normal
reaction_cn: 现象: 供电电压异常
reaction_en: Phenomenon: Abnormal power supply voltage
troubleshoot_cn:
1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、分别测量整车电瓶电压、EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果是电瓶电压低于16V，请对车辆电瓶充电、检查
4、如果EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间电压低于16V（12V系统电压低于9V），则为车辆供电异常，需将电压恢复至正常水平才可消除故障。测量线束有无接错、串电等现象，具体查找供电电压过低原因 ; 处理措施: 故障出现：控制器端24号针脚输入的电压低于16V超过5秒
故障消除：控制器端24号针脚输入的电压低于16V超过3秒
troubleshoot_en:
1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Measure the vehicle battery voltage and the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module valve harness end connector separately
3. If the battery voltage is below 16V, please charge and check the vehicle battery
4. If the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring terminal is lower than 16V (12V system voltage is lower than 9V), the power supply to the vehicle is abnormal, and the voltage needs to be restored to a normal level before the fault can be eliminated. Measure whether the wiring harness has any faults, backlighting, etc., and find out the cause of the power supply voltage being too low; Treatment: Fault occurs: The voltage input to pin 24 on the controller side is lower than 16V for more than 5 seconds
Troubleshooting: The voltage input on pin 24 on the controller is lower than 16V for more than 3 seconds

name_en: The main valve is not electrically connected
trigger_cn: 15电 ; 判断条件: 供电电压异常
trigger_en: KL15 on; judgment conditions: abnormal power supply voltage
clear_cn: 供电电压正常
clear_en: Power supply voltage is normal
reaction_cn: 现象: 供电电压异常
reaction_en: Phenomenon: Abnormal power supply voltage
troubleshoot_cn:
1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、分别测量整车电瓶电压、EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果是电瓶电压为0，请对车辆电瓶充电、检查
4、如果EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间无电压，测量线束有无接错、短路、断路、接插件端子是否松动等现象，具体查找阀电未接原因 ; 处理措施: 故障出现：控制器端24号针脚未检测到电压，超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端24号针脚恢复24V供电电压，超过3秒
troubleshoot_en:
1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Measure the vehicle battery voltage and the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module valve harness end connector separately
3. If the battery voltage is 0, please charge and check the vehicle battery
4. If there is no voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the connector on the EPB module valve harness end, measure whether the wiring harness is connected incorrectly, short circuit, broken circuit, or whether the connector terminal is loose, etc., and find out specifically why the valve is not connected; Treatment measures: Failure occurs: pin 24 on the controller side does not detect voltage for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 24 on the controller side restores the 24V supply voltage for more than 3 seconds

name_cn: 临停阀制动端对电源短路
name_en: The brake end of the stop-stop valve has a short circuit to the power supply
trigger_cn: 15电 ; 判断条件: 临停继动阀制动端对电源短路
trigger_en: KL15 on; judgment conditions: short circuit between the brake end of the stop-stop relay valve and the power supply
clear_cn: 线路正常
clear_en: The line is normal
reaction_cn: 现象: 临停继动阀制动端对电源短路
reaction_en: Phenomenon: The brake end of the stop-stop relay valve has a short circuit to the power supply
troubleshoot_cn:
1、在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
2、将临停阀接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量临停继动线束接插件3号引脚对地的电压，若有电压，则为线束问题，需检查线束是否破损，串电。
3.若线束没问题，则更换临停继动阀 ; 处理措施: 在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
故障出现：控制器端7号针脚与电源（24V）短接超过1秒，临停阀一直工作进气。
故障消除：控制器端7号针脚未检测到与电源短接，超过1秒

name_en: ON power supply is too high

reaction_en: Phenomenon: ON power supply is too high
troubleshoot_cn:
1、将整车上至ON挡电
2、将EPB模块总成控制器接插件拔下，测量EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与10号针脚之间的电压
3、如果EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与10号针脚之间电压高于32V（12V系统电压高于16V），则为车辆供电异常，需将电压恢复至正常水平才可消除故障。测量线束有无接错、串电等现象，具体查找供电电压过高原因 ; 处理措施: 故障出现：控制器端10号针脚输入的电压高于32V，超过5秒
故障消除：控制器端10号针脚输入的电压低于32V，超过1秒
troubleshoot_en:
1. Turn the whole vehicle on and turn off the electricity
2. Unplug the EPB module assembly controller connector and measure the voltage between pins 24 and 10 of the EPB module assembly wiring harness terminal
3. If the voltage between pins 24 and 10 of the EPB module assembly wiring terminal is higher than 32V (12V system voltage is higher than 16V), the power supply to the vehicle is abnormal, and the voltage needs to be restored to a normal level before the fault can be eliminated. Measure whether the wiring harness has any faults, string connections, etc., and find out the cause of the power supply voltage being too high; Treatment measures: The voltage input to pin 10 on the controller side is higher than 32V, more than 5 seconds
Troubleshooting: The input voltage of pin 10 on the controller is less than 32V, more than 1 second

步骤 1、拔下 ECU 的 15 孔插头，测量 15P-15 与 15P-4 或电源线是否短路；如果短路，进入步骤 2；如果没短路，进入步骤 4；

name_en: The unit is faulty due to lack of refrigerant
trigger_cn:
成熟条件: 机组缺冷媒故障：
当环境温度≥5℃，VDC检测高压压力值小于0.2Mpa，且持续时间超过5s，判断电池热管理缺少冷媒，禁止两侧压缩机、风扇工作，水泵正常工作，报电池热管理系统故障，电池热管理处于非冷却模式时，故障等级一级，处于冷却模式时，故障等级二级。

机组缺冷媒故障：
①当环境温度≥5℃，VDC检测高压和低压压力值同时小于0.2Mpa，且持续时间超过5s，判断电池热管理缺冷媒

②压缩机开启5min，检测压缩机启动后高压压力升高值＜200kPa，且低压压力下降值＜100kPa，判断电池热管理缺少冷媒。（此判断逻辑高压压力必须≤0.8Mpa同时高压压力和低压压力相差＜150kPa时情况下，当超过此值时，不做缺冷媒判断）

出现上述两条任一条时，禁止压缩机启动，报缺冷媒故障。
trigger_en:
Mature conditions: The unit is deficient in refrigerant and faults:
When the ambient temperature is ≥5℃, VDC detects that the high pressure value is less than 0.2MPa, and the duration exceeds 5s. It determines that the battery heat management lacks refrigerant, prohibits the compressor and fan from working on both sides, and reports a battery thermal management system failure. When the battery thermal management is in uncooled mode, the fault level is level 1, and when in cooling mode, the fault level is level 2.

The unit lacks refrigerant faults:
① When the ambient temperature is ≥5℃, VDC detects that the high and low pressure values are less than 0.2MPa at the same time, and the duration exceeds 5s to determine the lack of refrigerant for battery thermal management

② Open the compressor for 5 minutes to detect a high pressure increase value of <200 kPa and a low pressure drop value of <100 kPa after starting the compressor to determine that the battery heat management lacks refrigerant. (In this judgment logic, the high pressure pressure must be ≤ 0.8 MPa when the difference between high pressure and low pressure is <150 kPa, when it exceeds this value, no refrigerant shortage judgment is made)

When any of the above two conditions occur, the compressor is prohibited from starting, and a refrigerant failure is reported.

trigger_cn:
成熟条件: 触发条件：
运行中缺相：满足工况1或工况2的任意一种报出
工况1：（与载频和输出电流大小强相关；）
 1）运行中输出缺相检测使能（F10-17）
 2）运行频率>0.8Hz；
 3）控制器处于运行状态；
 4) 三相最大电流有效值/最小电流有效值≥11，三相最大电流有效值＞12.2%基值电流；
 5）条件4）每隔5个开关周期判断一次，连续满足5次，报出缺相故障。
工况2：（2ms检测一次；）
 1）输出交流电压大于额定电压&输出交流电流有效值小于1/40基值电流，
 2）同步电机类型运行频率小于1/4电机额定频率，异步电机无频率要求；
 3）同时满足1）和2），故障计数器+1，否则-1；如果故障计数器≥10，则报缺相故障。
上电缺相检测：满足以下所有条件持续4ms
 1）控制器第一次低压上电；
 2）第一次开管运行时分别发UV,VW,WU三相脉冲进行相序缺相检测。
PS：基值电流=Min（电机最大电流的0.5倍，控制器最大电流的0.25倍）

复位条件：
下电恢复
trigger_en:
Maturation conditions: Trigger conditions:
Phase loss during operation: satisfies any of the operating conditions 1 or 2
Working condition 1: (strongly related to carrier frequency and output current size;)
 1) Enable output phase loss detection during operation (F10-17)
 2) Operating frequency > 0.8 Hz;
 3) The controller is in operation;
 4) Three-phase maximum current effective value/minimum current effective value ≥11, three-phase maximum current effective value > 12.2% base value current;
 5) Condition 4) Determined every 5 switching cycles, satisfied 5 times in a row, and a missing phase fault is reported.
Working condition 2: (2ms test once;)
 1) The output AC voltage is greater than the rated voltage & the effective value of the output AC current is less than 1/40 of the base value current,
 2) The operating frequency of the synchronous motor type is less than 1/4 of the rated frequency of the motor, and the asynchronous motor has no frequency requirements;
 3) If 1) and 2) are satisfied at the same time, the fault counter is +1; otherwise, -1; if the fault counter is greater than 10, a phase loss fault is reported.
Power-on phase loss detection: lasts 4 ms when all of the following conditions are met
 1) The controller is powered on at low voltage for the first time;
 2) When the tube is first opened, UV, VW, and WU three-phase pulses are sent separately for phase sequence phase loss detection.
PS: base current = Min (0.5 times the maximum current of the motor, 0.25 times the maximum current of the controller)

Reset conditions:
Power-down recovery

trigger_cn:
运行中缺相：满足工况1或工况2的任意一种报出
工况1：
 1）运行中输出缺相检测使能（F10-17）
 2）运行频率>0.8Hz；
 3）控制器处于运行状态；
 4) 三相最大电流有效值/最小电流有效值≥11，三相最大电流有效值＞12.2%基值电流；
 5）条件4）每隔5个开关周期判断一次，连续满足5次，报出缺相故障。
工况2：
 1）输出交流电压大于额定电压&输出交流电流有效值小于1/40基值电流，
 2）同步电机类型运行频率小于1/4电机额定频率，异步电机无频率要求；
 3）同时满足1）和2），故障计数器+1，否则-1；如果故障计数器≥10，则报缺相故障。
上电缺相检测：满足以下所有条件持续4ms
 1）控制器第一次低压上电；
 2）第一次开管运行时分别发UV,VW,WU三相脉冲进行相序缺相检测。
PS：基值电流=Min（电机最大电流的0.5倍，控制器最大电流的0.25倍）; 诊断时间: 工况1：与载频和输出电流大小强相关；
工况2：2ms检测一次；

name_cn: 供电过高; ON档电供电电压过高（大于32V）
name_en: Too high power supply; ON mode power supply voltage is too high (greater than 32V)
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端25号针脚电压高于32V超过5秒
故障消除：控制器端25号针脚电压低于32V超过100毫秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurs: The voltage on pin 25 on the controller side is higher than 32V for more than 5 seconds
Troubleshooting: The voltage at pin 25 on the controller side is less than 32V for more than 100 ms
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 手动驻车、手动释放驻车、童锁、低压限制释放、临时停车、起步自动释放、坡起辅助、挂车独立制动、驻车力度检测、熄火驻车、应急制动
reaction_en: Failure functions: manual parking, manual release parking, child lock, low pressure limit release, temporary parking, automatic start release, slope assist, independent trailer braking, parking force detection, flameout parking, emergency braking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或供电电源; 1、将整车上至ON挡电
2、将EPB模块总成控制器接插件拔下，测量EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间电压高于32V（12V系统电压高于16V），则为车辆供电异常，需将电压恢复至正常水平才可消除故障。测量线束有无接错、串电等现象，具体查找供电电压过高原因
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or power supply; 1. Turn the vehicle on and turn off the power
2. Unplug the EPB module assembly controller connector and measure the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring harness terminal
3. If the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring terminal is higher than 32V (12V system voltage is higher than 16V), the power supply to the vehicle is abnormal, and the voltage needs to be restored to a normal level before the fault can be eliminated. Measure whether the wiring harness has any faults, string connections, etc., and find out the reason why the power supply voltage is too high

name_cn: 供电过低; ON档电供电电压过低（小于16V）
name_en: Too low power supply; ON mode power supply voltage is too low (less than 16V)
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端25号针脚电压低于16V超过5秒
故障消除：控制器端25号针脚电压高于于16V超过100毫秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurs: The voltage at pin 25 on the controller side falls below 16V for more than 5 seconds
Troubleshooting: The voltage at pin 25 on the controller side is higher than 16V for more than 100 ms
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 手动驻车、手动释放驻车、童锁、低压限制释放、临时停车、起步自动释放、坡起辅助、挂车独立制动、驻车力度检测、熄火驻车、应急制动
reaction_en: Failure functions: manual parking, manual release parking, child lock, low pressure limit release, temporary parking, automatic start release, slope assist, independent trailer braking, parking force detection, flameout parking, emergency braking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或供电电源; 1、将整车上至ON挡电
2、将EPB模块总成控制器接插件拔下，测量EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间电压低于16V（12V系统电压低于9V），则为车辆供电异常，需将电压恢复至正常水平才可消除故障。测量线束有无接错、串电等现象，具体查找供电电压过低原因
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or power supply; 1. Turn the vehicle on and turn off the power
2. Unplug the EPB module assembly controller connector and measure the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring harness terminal
3. If the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring terminal is lower than 16V (12V system voltage is lower than 9V), the power supply to the vehicle is abnormal, and the voltage needs to be restored to a normal level before the fault can be eliminated. Measure whether the wiring harness has any faults, backlighting, etc., and find out the reason why the power supply voltage is too low

name_cn: 阀电没接; EPB模块总成阀电（常电）未接
name_en: Valve electricity is not connected; EPB module assembly valve electricity (normal power) is not connected
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端25号针脚未检测到电压超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端25号针脚恢复24V供电电压超过100毫秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: pin 25 on the controller side did not detect a voltage for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 25 on the controller side restores the 24V supply voltage for more than 100 ms
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 手动驻车、手动释放驻车、童锁、低压限制释放、临时停车、起步自动释放、坡起辅助、挂车独立制动、驻车力度检测、熄火驻车、应急制动
reaction_en: Failure functions: manual parking, manual release parking, child lock, low pressure limit release, temporary parking, automatic start release, slope assist, independent trailer braking, parking force detection, flameout parking, emergency braking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或供电电源; 1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、分别测量整车电瓶电压、EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果是电瓶电压为0，请对车辆电瓶充电、检查
4、如果EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间无电压，测量线束有无接错、短路、断路、接插件端子是否松动等现象，具体查找阀电未接原因
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or power supply; 1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Measure the vehicle battery voltage and the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module valve harness end connector separately
3. If the battery voltage is 0, please charge and check the vehicle battery
4. If there is no voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the connector on the EPB module valve harness end, measure whether the wiring harness is connected incorrectly, short circuit, broken circuit, or whether the connector terminal is loose, etc., and find out specifically why the valve is not connected

name_cn: CAN报文丢失; CAN报文丢失或延时
name_en: CAN message lost; CAN message lost or delayed
trigger_cn:
故障出现：CAN报文出现丢失或延时超过3秒
故障消除：CAN报文通讯恢复正常超过3秒
trigger_en:
Failure occurred: CAN messages were lost or delayed for more than 3 seconds
Troubleshooting: CAN message communication returned to normal for more than 3 seconds
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 童锁、低压限制释放、临时停车、起步自动释放、坡起辅助、挂车独立制动、驻车力度检测、熄火驻车、应急制动
reaction_en: Failure functions: child lock, low pressure limit release, temporary parking, automatic start release, ramp assist, independent trailer braking, parking force detection, flameout parking, emergency braking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 发送报文的系统或网关; 1、检查有哪些报文丢失或延时超过3秒
2、发送这些报文出来的系统是否能正常发送
3、如果在不同CAN网络上，检查转发的机构是否正常工作
4、检查CAN网络是否负载过高，通讯拥堵
troubleshoot_en:
Location of fault: The system or gateway that sent the message; 1. Check which messages were lost or delayed for more than 3 seconds
2. Whether the system that sent these messages can send them normally
3. If on a different CAN network, check whether the forwarding agency is working properly
4. Check whether the CAN network is overloaded and the communication is congested

trigger_cn:
故障出现：CAN线断路，无法接收和发送报文
故障消除：CAN线连接恢复正常连续接收到10帧以上报文。
trigger_en:
Fault occurs: CAN line is broken, unable to receive and send messages
Troubleshooting: The CAN cable connection returns to normal and continuously receives more than 10 frames of messages.
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 童锁、低压限制释放、临时停车、起步自动释放、坡起辅助、挂车独立制动、驻车力度检测、熄火驻车、应急制动
reaction_en: Failure functions: child lock, low pressure limit release, temporary parking, automatic start release, ramp assist, independent trailer braking, parking force detection, flameout parking, emergency braking
troubleshoot_cn: 故障部位: CAN线; 检查EPB系统CAN线是否存在断路现象
troubleshoot_en: Fault location: CAN line; check whether the EPB system CAN line is broken

name_cn: 开关内部故障; EPB开关发生故障
name_en: Internal switch failure; EPB switch failure
trigger_cn:
故障出现：EPB开关或连接线束出现故障，超过3秒
故障消除：EPB开关或连接线束出现故障，恢复超过3秒
trigger_en:
Failure occurred: EPB switch or connection harness failed for more than 3 seconds
Troubleshooting: EPB switch or connection harness failed, recovery for more than 3 seconds
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 手动驻车、手动释放驻车、挂车独立制动、驻车力度检测、应急制动
reaction_en: Failure functions: manual parking, manual release parking, independent trailer braking, parking strength detection, emergency braking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: EPB开关; 1、检查开关线束接插件有无松动
2、开关线束有无短、断路
3、拉开关检测开关开关6、9号引脚两路线性电压成比例
4、驻车释放开关常位和驻车制动两个引脚电压是否同时为0V
排查时如果有一下情况则报故障：
a、任何时候6号引脚电压乘2与9号引脚电压相差不能大于0.3v
b、任何时候1号引脚和5号引脚同时为0v
c、往下按释放开关结合时候 (1号引脚为高电平，5号引脚为高电亚) 时，开关开度输出电压不能大于0.3v
d、往上拉驻车开关结合时候 (1号引脚为低电平，5号引脚为高电平) 时，开关开度输出电压要大于3.6v
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: EPB switch; 1. Check whether the switch wiring connector is loose
2. Whether the switch wiring is short or broken
3. Pull the switch to check that the two linear voltages on pins 6 and 9 of the switch are proportional
4. Whether the two pin voltages of the parking release switch and parking brake are 0V at the same time
Report a fault if there are any of the following conditions during troubleshooting:
a. At any time, the difference between pin 6 voltage times 2 and pin 9 voltage cannot be greater than 0.3v
b. Any time pin 1 and pin 5 are 0v at the same time
c. When the release switch is combined by pressing down (pin 1 is high, pin 5 is high voltage), the switch opening output voltage cannot be greater than 0.3v
d. When the parking switch is pulled up (pin 1 is low level, pin 5 is high level), the switch opening output voltage is greater than 3.6v

name_cn: 阀体内部故障; EPB模块总成阀体内部故障
name_en: Internal valve body failure; EPB module assembly valve body internal failure
trigger_cn:
故障出现：EPB模块总成内部出现故障，超过1秒
故障消除：EPB模块总成内部故障恢复，超过1秒
trigger_en:
Failure occurred: The EPB module assembly failed internally for more than 1 second
Fault elimination: EPB module assembly internal fault recovery, more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 起步自动释放、坡起辅助
reaction_en: Failure function: automatic start release, slope assist
troubleshoot_cn: 故障部位: EPB模块总成阀体内部的线圈短断路、倾角传感器、压力传感器损坏; 更换EPB模块总成
troubleshoot_en: Fault location: Short coil circuit in the EPB module assembly valve body, damage to the inclination sensor and pressure sensor; replace the EPB module assembly

name_cn: 临停阀制动端对电源短路; 临停继动阀制动端对电源短路
name_en: Short circuit between the brake end of the stop valve to the power supply; the brake end of the stop relay valve short circuit to the power supply
trigger_cn:
在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
故障出现：控制器端7号针脚与电源（24V）短接超过1秒，临停阀一直工作进气。
故障消除：控制器端7号针脚未检测到与电源短接，超过1秒
trigger_en:
When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
Fault occurred: Pin 7 on the controller end was shorted to the power supply (24V) for more than 1 second, and the stop-valve kept working to intake air.
Troubleshooting: Pin 7 on the controller side did not detect a short connection to the power supply for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或临停继动阀制动端电磁阀; 1、在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
2、将临停阀接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量临停继动线束接插件3号引脚对地的电压，若有电压，则为线束问题，需检查线束是否破损，串电。
3.若线束没问题，则更换临停继动阀
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or stop-stop relay valve brake end solenoid valve; 1. When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
2. Unplug the stop-stop valve connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly and measure the voltage on pin 3 of the stop-stop relay harness connector to the ground. If there is voltage, it is a wiring problem. You need to check whether the wiring harness is damaged or connected.
3. If the wiring harness is OK, replace the stop-stop relay valve

name_cn: 临停阀制动端对地短路; 临停继动阀制动端对地短路
name_en: Stop valve brake end to ground short circuit; stop relay valve brake end to ground short circuit
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端7号针脚检测到与地线短接，超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端7号针脚未检测到与地线短接，超过1秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: Pin 7 on the controller side detected a short connection with the ground wire for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 7 on the controller side did not detect a short connection to the ground wire for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或临停继动阀制动端电磁阀; 1、在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
2、将临停阀接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量临停继动线束接插件3号引脚是否对地短路，若有短路，则为线束问题，需检查线束是否破损，搭铁。
3.若线束没问题，则更换临停继动阀
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or stop-stop relay valve brake end solenoid valve; 1. When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
2. Unplug the stop-valve connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly to measure whether pin 3 of the stop-stop relay harness connector is short circuited to the ground. If there is a short circuit, it is a wiring problem. You need to check whether the wiring harness is damaged and attached to the iron.
3. If the wiring harness is OK, replace the stop-stop relay valve

name_cn: 临停阀制动端断路; 临停继动阀制动端断路
name_en: The brake end of the stop valve is broken; the brake end of the stop relay valve is broken
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端7号针脚未检测到与临停阀连接断开超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端7号针脚检测到临停阀重新连接超过1秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: pin 7 on the controller side did not detect disconnection from the stop valve for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 7 on the controller side detects that the stop-valve has been reconnected for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或临停继动阀制动端电磁阀; 1、在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
2、将临停阀接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量临停继动线束接插件3号引脚与EPB模块总成25P线束接插件之间是否断路，若断路，则为线束问题，需修复线束短路问题。
3.若线束没问题，将线束接插件插回，重新上电，若仍报该故障码，则更换临停继动阀
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or stop-stop relay valve brake end solenoid valve; 1. When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
2. Unplug the stop-stop valve connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly to measure whether the circuit is broken between pin 3 of the stop-stop relay harness connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly. If the circuit is broken, it is a wiring problem, and the short circuit problem of the wiring harness needs to be fixed.
3. If there is no problem with the wiring harness, plug in the wiring harness connector and power it back on. If the fault code is still reported, replace the stop-stop relay valve

name_cn: 临停排气对电源短路; 临停继动阀缓解端对电源短路
name_en: Stop exhaust short circuit to power supply; stop relay valve mitigates short circuit end to power supply
trigger_cn:
在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
故障出现：控制器端6号针脚检测到与电源（24V）短接，超过1秒，临停阀一直工作排气。
故障消除：控制器端6号针脚未检测到与电源短接，超过1秒
trigger_en:
When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
Fault occurred: Pin 6 on the controller side detected a short connection to the power supply (24V). For more than 1 second, the stop valve continued to work and exhaust.
Troubleshooting: Pin 6 on the controller side did not detect a short connection to the power supply for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或临停继动阀缓解端电磁阀; 1、在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
2、将临停阀接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量临停继动线束接插件1号引脚对地的电压，若有电压，则为线束问题，需检查线束是否破损，串电。
3.若线束没问题，则更换临停继动阀
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: solenoid valve at the relief end of the wiring harness or stop-stop relay valve; 1. When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
2. Unplug the stop-stop valve connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly and measure the voltage on pin 1 of the stop-stop relay harness connector to the ground. If there is voltage, it is a wiring problem. You need to check whether the wiring harness is damaged or connected.
3. If the wiring harness is OK, replace the stop-stop relay valve

name_cn: 临停排气对地短路; 临停继动阀缓解端对地短路
name_en: Stop exhaust short circuit to ground; stop relay valve mitigates end to ground short circuit
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端6号针脚检测到与地线短接，超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端6号针脚未检测到与地线短接，超过1秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: Pin 6 on the controller side detected a short connection with the ground wire for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 6 on the controller side did not detect a short connection with the ground wire for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或临停继动阀缓解端电磁阀; 1、在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
2、将临停阀接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量临停继动线束接插件1号引脚是否对地短路，若有短路，则为线束问题，需检查线束是否破损，搭铁。
3.若线束没问题，则更换临停继动阀
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: solenoid valve at the relief end of the wiring harness or stop-stop relay valve; 1. When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
2. Unplug the stop-valve connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly to measure whether pin 1 of the stop-stop relay harness connector is short circuited to the ground. If there is a short circuit, it is a wiring problem. You need to check whether the wiring harness is damaged and attached to the iron.
3. If the wiring harness is OK, replace the stop-stop relay valve

name_cn: 临停排气断路; 临停继动阀缓解端断路
name_en: Temporary exhaust circuit; stop-stop relay valve mitigates end failure
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端6号针脚未检测到与临停阀连接，断开超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端6号针脚检测到临停阀重新连接，超过1秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: Pin 6 on the controller side did not detect a connection with the stop-stop valve and was disconnected for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 6 on the controller side detected a stop-valve reconnection for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或临停继动阀缓解端电磁阀; 1、在临停继动阀不起作用的情况下
2、将临停阀接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量临停继动线束接插件1号引脚与EPB模块总成25P线束接插件之间是否断路，若断路，则为线束问题，需修复线束短路问题。
3.若线束没问题，将线束接插件插回，重新上电，若仍报该故障码，则更换临停继动阀
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: solenoid valve at the relief end of the wiring harness or stop-stop relay valve; 1. When the stop-stop relay valve does not work
2. Unplug the stop-stop valve connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly and measure whether the circuit is broken between pin 1 of the stop-stop relay harness connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly. If the circuit is broken, it is a wiring problem, and the wiring harness short circuit problem needs to be fixed.
3. If there is no problem with the wiring harness, plug in the wiring harness connector and power it back on. If the fault code is still reported, replace the stop-stop relay valve

name_cn: 挂车独立制动端对电源短路; 挂车独立制动电磁阀对电源短路
name_en: Trailer independent braking end short circuit to power supply; trailer independent braking solenoid valve short circuit to power supply
trigger_cn:
故障出现：模块总成内部挂车独立制动阀芯与电源（24V）短接，超过1秒
故障消除：模块总成内部挂车独立制动阀芯恢复正常超过1秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: The independent brake valve core of the trailer inside the module assembly was short-connected to the power supply (24V) for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: The independent brake valve core of the trailer inside the module assembly returned to normal for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 挂车独立制动
reaction_en: Failure function: independent braking of the trailer
troubleshoot_cn: 故障部位: EPB模块总成; 更换EPB模块总成
troubleshoot_en: Fault location: EPB module assembly; replace EPB module assembly

name_cn: 挂车独立制动端对地短路; 挂车独立制动电磁阀对地短路
name_en: Trailer independent braking end to ground short circuit; trailer independent braking solenoid valve short circuit to ground
trigger_cn:
故障出现：模块总成内部挂车独立制动阀芯与地短接，超过1秒，挂车独立制动阀一直工作
故障消除：模块总成内部挂车独立制动阀芯恢复正常超过1秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: The independent brake valve core of the trailer inside the module assembly was short-connected to the ground. For more than 1 second, the independent brake valve of the trailer worked all the time
Troubleshooting: The independent brake valve core of the trailer inside the module assembly returned to normal for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 手动驻车、手动释放驻车、起步自动释放、坡起辅助、熄火驻车、应急制动
reaction_en: Failure functions: manual parking, manual release parking, automatic start-up release, slope assist, flameout parking, emergency braking
troubleshoot_cn: 故障部位: EPB模块总成; 更换EPB模块总成
troubleshoot_en: Fault location: EPB module assembly; replace EPB module assembly

name_cn: 挂车独立制动端断路; 挂车独立制动电磁阀断路
name_en: Trailer independent braking end disconnected; trailer independent braking solenoid valve disconnected
trigger_cn:
故障出现：模块总成内部挂车独立制动阀芯未连接，超过1秒
故障消除：模块总成内部挂车独立制动阀芯恢复连接，超过1秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: The independent brake valve core of the trailer inside the module assembly was not connected for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: The independent brake valve core of the trailer within the module assembly was restored for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 挂车独立制动
reaction_en: Failure function: independent braking of the trailer
troubleshoot_cn: 故障部位: EPB模块总成; 更换EPB模块总成
troubleshoot_en: Fault location: EPB module assembly; replace EPB module assembly

name_cn: EBS故障无法响应临停; EBS系统无法响应临时停车制动请求
name_en: EBS failure is unable to respond to stoppage; EBS system is unable to respond to temporary parking brake requests
trigger_cn:
配置为EBS做临停的情况下
故障出现：进行临停制动时，EPB发出制动请求，1秒内EBS系统不响应请求
故障消除：关闭钥匙电重启
trigger_en:
When configured for EBS to stop
Fault occurs: EPB issues a braking request during stop-braking, and the EBS system does not respond to the request within 1 second
Troubleshooting: Turn off the key and restart
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: EBS系统; 1、检查EBS系统有无红灯故障;
2、检查EPB系统发出请求后，EBS系统能否响应请求并执行制动（将系统重新上电，待制动系统响应异常故障消除，开动车辆，模拟进行临时停车制动，采集报文观察，当EPB发送报文中”halt brake" Switch状态为halt brake switch active时，1秒内EBC5报文中Halt brake mode状态是否变为active，若不是，则为EBS未响应EPB系统的制动请求，需要EBS相关人员进行排查调整。）
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: EBS system; 1. Check if the EBS system has a red light fault;
2. Check whether the EBS system can respond to the request and perform braking after the EPB system issues the request (power up the system again, wait for the braking system to resolve abnormal faults, start the vehicle, simulate temporary parking and braking, and collect and observe the message. When the “halt brake” switch state is HALT brake switch active in the EPB transmission message, whether the HALT brake mode state in the EBC5 message becomes active within 1 second. If not, then EBS has not responded to the EPB system (Braking requests require investigation and adjustment by relevant EBS personnel.)

name_cn: 主阀电供电过高; 主阀电电压高于32V
name_en: The main valve power supply is too high; the main valve voltage is higher than 32V
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端25号针脚输入的电压高于32V超过5秒
故障消除：控制器端25号针脚输入的电压低于32V超过3秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurs: The voltage input on pin 25 on the controller side is higher than 32V for more than 5 seconds
Troubleshooting: The voltage input on pin 25 on the controller is lower than 32V for more than 3 seconds
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 无
reaction_en: Disabled function: no
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或供电电源; 1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、将EPB模块总成控制器接插件拔下，测量EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间电压高于32V（12V系统电压高于16V），则为车辆供电异常，需将电压恢复至正常水平才可消除故障。测量线束有无接错、串电等现象，具体查找供电电压过高原因
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or power supply; 1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Unplug the EPB module assembly controller connector and measure the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring harness terminal
3. If the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring terminal is higher than 32V (12V system voltage is higher than 16V), the power supply to the vehicle is abnormal, and the voltage needs to be restored to a normal level before the fault can be eliminated. Measure whether the wiring harness has any faults, string connections, etc., and find out the reason why the power supply voltage is too high

name_cn: 主阀电供电过低; 主阀电电压低于16V
name_en: The main valve power supply is too low; the main valve voltage is less than 16V
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端25号针脚输入的电压低于16V超过5秒
故障消除：控制器端25号针脚输入的电压高于16V超过3秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurs: The voltage input on pin 25 on the controller side falls below 16V for more than 5 seconds
Troubleshooting: The voltage input on pin 25 on the controller is higher than 16V for more than 3 seconds
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 无
reaction_en: Disabled function: no
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或供电电源; 1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、分别测量整车电瓶电压、EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果是电瓶电压低于16V，请对车辆电瓶充电、检查
4、如果EPB模块总成线束端接插件的24号与25号针脚之间电压低于16V（12V系统电压低于9V），则为车辆供电异常，需将电压恢复至正常水平才可消除故障。测量线束有无接错、串电等现象，具体查找供电电压过低原因
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or power supply; 1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Measure the vehicle battery voltage and the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module valve harness end connector separately
3. If the battery voltage is below 16V, please charge and check the vehicle battery
4. If the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module assembly wiring terminal is lower than 16V (12V system voltage is lower than 9V), the power supply to the vehicle is abnormal, and the voltage needs to be restored to a normal level before the fault can be eliminated. Measure whether the wiring harness has any faults, backlighting, etc., and find out the reason why the power supply voltage is too low

name_cn: 主阀电没接; 主阀电未接
name_en: The main valve is not electrically connected; the main valve is not electrically connected
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端25号针脚未检测到电压，超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端25号针脚恢复24V供电电压，超过3秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: No voltage was detected on pin 25 on the controller end for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 25 on the controller side restores the 24V supply voltage for more than 3 seconds
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 无
reaction_en: Disabled function: no
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或供电电源; 1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、分别测量整车电瓶电压、EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间的电压
3、如果是电瓶电压为0，请对车辆电瓶充电、检查
4、如果EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的24号与25号针脚之间无电压，测量线束有无接错、短路、断路、接插件端子是否松动等现象，具体查找阀电未接原因
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or power supply; 1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Measure the vehicle battery voltage and the voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the EPB module valve harness end connector separately
3. If the battery voltage is 0, please charge and check the vehicle battery
4. If there is no voltage between pins 24 and 25 of the connector on the EPB module valve harness end, measure whether the wiring harness is connected incorrectly, short circuit, broken circuit, or whether the connector terminal is loose, etc., and find out specifically why the valve is not connected

name_cn: 备用阀电源未接; 备用阀电未接
name_en: Backup valve power is not connected; backup valve is not connected
trigger_cn:
故障出现：控制器端9号针脚未检测到电压，超过1秒
故障消除：控制器端9号针脚恢复24V供电电压，超过3秒
trigger_en:
Fault occurred: No voltage was detected on pin 9 on the controller end for more than 1 second
Troubleshooting: Pin 9 on the controller side restores the 24V supply voltage for more than 3 seconds
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 无
reaction_en: Disabled function: no
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 线束或供电电源; 1、将整车总电源开关打开
2、分别测量整车电瓶电压、EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的8号与9号针脚之间的电压
3、如果是电瓶电压为0，请对车辆电瓶充电、检查
4、如果EPB模块阀线束端的接插件的8号与9号针脚之间无电压，测量线束有无接错、短路、断路、接插件端子是否松动等现象，具体查找阀电未接原因
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: wiring harness or power supply; 1. Turn on the vehicle's main power switch
2. Measure the vehicle battery voltage separately and the voltage between pins 8 and 9 of the connector at the EPB module valve harness end
3. If the battery voltage is 0, please charge and check the vehicle battery
4. If there is no voltage between pins 8 and 9 of the connector on the EPB module valve harness end, measure whether the wiring harness is connected incorrectly, short circuit, broken circuit, or whether the connector terminal is loose, etc., and find out specifically why the valve is not connected to electricity

name_cn: 行车压力传感器低于量程范围; 行车压力传感器输出异常
name_en: The driving pressure sensor is below the range; the driving pressure sensor output is abnormal
trigger_cn:
未踩脚刹情况下
故障出现：控制器端2号针脚输入电压小于0.2V，超过10秒
故障消除：控制器端2号针脚输入电压恢复0.5V左右，超过1秒
trigger_en:
Without stepping on the foot brake
Fault occurs: The input voltage of pin 2 on the controller side is less than 0.2V for more than 10 seconds
Troubleshooting: The input voltage of pin 2 on the controller side recovers about 0.5V for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 行车压力传感器; 1、在行车压力传感器不起作用的情况下
2、将行车压力传感器接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量行车压力传感器接插件3号引脚是否对地短路，或断路。若有短路、断路，则为线束问题，需检查线束是否破损，搭铁。
3.若线束没问题，则更换行车压力传感器
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: driving pressure sensor; 1. When the driving pressure sensor does not work
2. Unplug the driving pressure sensor connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly to measure whether pin 3 of the driving pressure sensor connector is short circuited or broken to the ground. If there is a short circuit or a broken circuit, it is a wiring problem. You need to check whether the wiring harness is damaged and use the railway.
3. If the wiring is OK, replace the driving pressure sensor

name_cn: 行车压力传感器超过量产范围; 行车压力传感器输出异常
name_en: The driving pressure sensor exceeds the mass production range; the driving pressure sensor output is abnormal
trigger_cn:
未踩脚刹情况下
故障出现：控制器端2号针脚输入电压大于4.8V，超过10秒
故障消除：控制器端2号针脚输入电压恢复0.5V左右，超过1秒
trigger_en:
Without stepping on the foot brake
Fault occurs: The input voltage of pin 2 on the controller side is greater than 4.8V for more than 10 seconds
Troubleshooting: The input voltage of pin 2 on the controller side recovers about 0.5V for more than 1 second
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn:
故障部位: 行车压力传感器; 1、在行车压力传感器不起作用的情况下
2、将行车压力传感器接插件、EPB模块总成25P线束接插件拔下，测量行车压力传感器接插件3号引脚是否对电短路。若有短路，则为线束问题，需检查线束是否破损，串电。
3、若线束没问题，则更换行车压力传感器
troubleshoot_en:
Fault location: driving pressure sensor; 1. When the driving pressure sensor does not work
2. Unplug the driving pressure sensor connector and the 25P wiring harness connector of the EPB module assembly, and measure whether pin 3 of the driving pressure sensor connector is electrically short circuited. If there is a short circuit, it is a wiring problem. You need to check whether the wiring harness is damaged and connected.
3. If the wiring is OK, replace the driving pressure sensor

name_cn: 制动状态低于正常的行车压力; 车辆制动时，制动管路无气
name_en: The braking state is lower than normal driving pressure; when the vehicle brakes, there is no air in the brake line
trigger_cn:
临停继动阀工作时
故障出现：压力传感器采集到气压小于1bar超过1s
故障消除：临停工作压力传感器检测到行车制动管路有气压超过1bar压力1s以上
trigger_en:
When the stop-stop relay valve is working
Failure occurred: The pressure sensor collected air pressure less than 1 bar and more than 1 s
Troubleshooting: The stoppage pressure sensor detects that the air pressure in the driving brake line exceeds 1 bar pressure for 1 s or more
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn: 故障部位: 制动管路; 检查行车制动管路是否漏气，临停阀是否漏气，压力传感器是否损坏
troubleshoot_en: Fault location: brake line; check whether the driving brake line is leaking, whether the stop valve is leaking, and whether the pressure sensor is damaged

name_cn: 行车状态高于正常的行车压力; 车辆未制动时，制动管路有气
name_en: The driving state is higher than normal driving pressure; when the vehicle is not braked, there is air in the brake line
trigger_cn:
车速大于5km/h情况下
故障出现：踩油门后监控压力传感器监测行车气路，检测一直有气压高于1bar超过10s
故障消除：压力传感器监测到行车管路气压低于1bar压力1s以上
trigger_en:
When the vehicle speed is greater than 5 km/h
Fault occurred: After stepping on the throttle, the pressure sensor monitors the driving air path. The test always showed that the air pressure was higher than 1 bar for more than 10s
Troubleshooting: The pressure sensor detects that the air pressure in the driving line is lower than 1 bar pressure for 1 s or more
reaction_cn: 失效功能: 临时停车
reaction_en: Disabled function: temporary parking
troubleshoot_cn: 故障部位: 制动管路; 检查行车制动管路是否串气，压力传感器是否损坏
troubleshoot_en: Fault location: brake line; check whether the driving brake line is strained and whether the pressure sensor is damaged

name_cn: 行车气路漏气速率过大; 制动管路漏气
name_en: The driving air circuit leakage rate is too high; the brake line is leaking
trigger_cn:
临停继动阀工作情况下
故障出现：压力传感器监测行车气路，检测到管路频繁漏气补气，连续工作3个周期无法建立临停设置的压力
故障消除：关闭钥匙电重启
trigger_en:
When the stop-stop relay valve is working

trigger_cn:

troubleshoot_en: Fault location: EPB switch; unplug the EPB switch connector and measure whether the power supply voltage between pin 3 and pin 7 of the switch connector is abnormal (greater than 32V or lower than 16V)

reaction_cn: 失效功能: 手动驻车、手动释放驻车、童锁、低压限制释放、挂车独立制动、驻车力度检测、应急制动

troubleshoot_cn:
可能原因: 一、二桥EPM CAN通讯不正常; 维修建议: 1、检查EPM阀模块与控制器（ECU）间的供电以及CAN线束连接是否正常

Possible reasons: 1. The two-axle EPM CAN communication is not normal; maintenance suggestions: 1. Check whether the power supply and CAN wiring connection between the EPM valve module and the controller (ECU) are normal
2. Replace the EPM valve module

trigger_cn: 使能条件: 控制器上电; 设置条件: 三桥EPM CAN通讯异常

clear_cn: 三桥EPM CAN正常通讯
clear_en: Three-axle EPM CAN normal communication
troubleshoot_cn:
可能原因: 三桥EPM CAN通讯不正常; 维修建议: 1、检查三桥EPM阀模块与二桥EPM阀模块间的供电以及CAN线束连接是否正常
2、更换EPM阀模块
troubleshoot_en:
Possible reasons: Three-axle EPM CAN communication is not normal; Maintenance suggestions: 1. Check whether the power supply and CAN wiring connection between the three-axle EPM valve module and the two-axle EPM valve module are normal
2. Replace the EPM valve module

trigger_cn: 使能条件: 控制器上电; 设置条件: ESC CAN通讯异常
trigger_en: Enabling Condition: Controller Power-On; Setting Condition: ESC CAN Communication Abnormal
clear_cn: ESC CAN正常通讯
clear_en: ESC CAN normal communication
troubleshoot_cn:
可能原因: ESC CAN通讯不正常; 维修建议: 1、检查转向角、横摆率传感器是否标零（激活）
2、检查转向角、横摆率传感器与控制器（ECU）间的供电以及CAN线束连接是否正常
3、更换转向角或横摆率传感器或控制器（ECU）
troubleshoot_en:
Possible reasons: ESC CAN communication is not normal; maintenance suggestions: 1. Check whether the steering angle and slew rate sensors are zero (active)
2. Check whether the power supply and CAN wiring between the steering angle and slew rate sensor and controller (ECU) are normal
3. Replace the steering angle or slew rate sensor or controller (ECU)

trigger_cn: 使能条件: 控制器上电; 设置条件: 阀电源供电异常（阀电源短路）
trigger_en: Enabling conditions: Controller is powered on; Setting conditions: Valve power supply is abnormal (valve power supply short circuit)
clear_cn: 阀电源供电正常
clear_en: Valve power supply is normal
troubleshoot_cn: 可能原因: 阀电源出现短路现象; 维修建议: 更换控制器（ECU）
troubleshoot_en: Possible reason: Valve power supply short circuit; Maintenance recommendation: replace the controller (ECU)

trigger_cn: 使能条件: 控制器上电; 设置条件: 阀电源供电异常（阀电源断路）
trigger_en: Enabling conditions: Controller is powered on; Setting conditions: Valve power supply is abnormal (valve power supply is disconnected)
clear_cn: 阀电源供电正常
clear_en: Valve power supply is normal
troubleshoot_cn:
可能原因: 阀电源出现断路现象; 维修建议: 1、检查常电（KL30）的保险丝是否烧坏
2、检查阀电源供电是否正常（线束连接是否正常）
(W版 阀电源：X1-8、X1-9引脚)
(K版 阀电源：X1-16、X1-17引脚)
3、更换控制器（ECU）
troubleshoot_en:
Possible reason: The valve power supply is broken; maintenance suggestions: 1. Check whether the fuse of the normal current (KL30) is burnt out
2. Check whether the valve power supply is normal (whether the wiring connection is normal)
(W version valve power supply: X1-8, X1-9 pins)
(K version valve power supply: X1-16, X1-17 pins)
3. Replace the controller (ECU)

name_cn: 左三传感器与齿圈间隙过大
name_en: The gap between the left three sensors and the gear ring is too large
trigger_cn: 使能条件: 控制器上电，车辆处于行驶状态; 设置条件: 传感器与齿圈间隙过大
trigger_en: Enabling conditions: The controller is powered on and the vehicle is running; Setting conditions: The gap between the sensor and the gear ring is too large
clear_cn: 将传感器推到与齿圈间无间隙状态
clear_en: Push the sensor to a state where there is no gap between it and the gear ring
troubleshoot_cn:
可能原因: 传感器与齿圈间隙过大; 维修建议: 1、检查对应传感器及其固定支架是否存在松动
2、检查传感器与齿圈的间隙是否过大，两者的间隙需要≤0.75mm
troubleshoot_en:
Possible causes: The gap between the sensor and the gear ring is too large; maintenance suggestions: 1. Check whether the corresponding sensor and its fixing bracket are loose
2. Check whether the gap between the sensor and the gear ring is too large. The gap between the two needs to be ≤0.75mm

trigger_cn: 使能条件: 控制器上电; 设置条件: 传感器短路
trigger_en: Enabling Condition: Controller Powering Up; Setting Condition: Sensor Short Circuit
clear_cn: 传感器不短路
clear_en: The sensor is not short-circuited
troubleshoot_cn:
可能原因: 传感器短路; 维修建议: 1、检查对应传感器的接线和对应的电器接插件是否存在短路
2、检查对应传感器内部是否存在短路（单独测量传感器电阻值，正常为1250±100Ω），若不正常则更换传感器
3、更换三桥EPM阀模块
troubleshoot_en:
Possible causes: sensor short circuit; maintenance suggestions: 1. Check the corresponding sensor wiring and corresponding electrical connectors for short circuits
2. Check whether there is a short circuit inside the corresponding sensor (measure the sensor resistance value separately, the normal value is 1250±100Ω), and if not, replace the sensor
3. Replace the three-axle EPM valve module

trigger_cn:
进入条件: PowerOn; 运行中缺相：满足工况1或工况2的任意一种报出
工况1：
1）运行中输出缺相检测使能（F10-17）
2）运行频率>0.8Hz；
3）控制器处于运行状态；
4) 三相最大电流有效值/最小电流有效值≥11，三相最大电流有效值＞12.2%基值电流；
5）条件4）每隔5个开关周期判断一次，连续满足5次，报出缺相故障。
工况2：

可能原因 Possible causes: 传感器短路; 维修建议 Corrective action: 1、检查对应传感器的接线和对应的电器接插件是否存在短路

3. Replace the front axle EPM valve module
